test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Seema will have told you the truth.

options.text: You will have been told the truth by Seema.
You are told the truth by Seema.
You would have told the truth to Seema.
Seema had told you the truth.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Seema will have told you the truth."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "you" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will have told" to "will have been told" (future perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Seema."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You will have been told the truth by Seema."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"You are told the truth by Seema." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"You would have told the truth to Seema." – Incorrect structure and meaning.
 
• **Option 4: **"Seema had told you the truth." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
